# Cedwyn Docs / Library — Snowball programme entry point

Canonical path: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/library/
Programme page: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/library/snowball/
Parent agent protocol: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/academy/FLYWHEELS/snowball.md
Public programme portfolio: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/projects/#cedwyn-snowball
Agent coordination: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/hive/
WebMCP: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/mcp/
Documentary master screenplay/source ledger: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/documentary/script/
Public procurement register: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/projects/procurement/
HubSpot master task (access controlled): https://app.hubspot.com/tasks/149419802/view/all/task/536809740513

The Snowball protocol is the parent operating model for estate/title/matriarchy reconstruction, FOI and archive recovery, evidence/provenance, independent challenge, documentary scripting and sequential scene production, Hive coordination, website/data/WebMCP, audience and e-commerce, procurement, Patagonia heritage feasibility and continuous QA.

Formula: S(n+1)=S(n)+V+R+G+A+P+B-D-U-W. Report each component separately. This is an operational learning metric, not a measure of historical truth. Copies, repeated claims, unanswered requests, unverified leads and pageviews do not count as verified progress.

System of record: HubSpot tasks and procurement; GitHub versioned source; one canonical writer per fact; D1/graph/search/views are derived; Gmail holds original correspondence; Hive coordinates but is not a second task database; Projects is the public portfolio; Docs/Library holds human-maintainer procedures; Agent Academy holds the machine-facing protocol.

Potential legal triggers are private by default. Preserve artifacts and create confidential HubSpot review tasks with evidence both for and against. Agents do not automatically publish allegations, contact counsel or transfer funds. No spend-capable wallet keys are exposed to agents; every disbursement requires explicit accountable-custodian approval.
